description: Any registered Wisconsin voter can vote absentee, no excuse needed. Requests must be received by 5 PM Thursday, October 29. Your ballot needs an adult witness signature and must be delivered by 8 PM on Tuesday, November 3. Official state service: myvote.wi.gov/en-US/VoteAbsenteeByMail.
title: Request your absentee ballot · by 5 PM Thu, Oct 29 · Adam Duda for State Senate
